purpose: Production-gate validation of the accepted Chapter 6 ROE, OCF/NP and BP factor scope

universe.membership_rule: listed on each evaluation date using historical provider metadata
universe.st_policy: exclude ST, *ST and delisting-consolidation names using only formation-date status
universe.financial_sector_policy: included in primary analysis; additionally reported as separate robustness stratum

pit_and_factor_semantics.financial_effective_date: strictly next tradable session after publish_date
pit_and_factor_semantics.financial_record_selection: latest effective revision known at evaluation_date
pit_and_factor_semantics.stale_policy: reuse frozen Chapter 6 stale policy without recalibration on OOS
pit_and_factor_semantics.preprocessing: reuse frozen MAD preprocessing without OOS recalibration

return_contract.endpoint_suspension_or_missing_price: NaN with audit reason; no rolling, filling or interpolation
return_contract.delisting: auditable termination value or explicit NaN

portfolio_evidence.primary_sort: five equal-count factor quantiles per evaluation date
portfolio_evidence.long_short_diagnostic_only: Q5 minus Q1; no shortability claim
portfolio_evidence.turnover: one-way weight turnover from pre-trade to target weights
portfolio_evidence.capacity: report 20-day ADV and flag trades above 10 percent participation

cost_policy.broker_commission_semantics: research assumption inclusive of exchange handling and regulatory fees

statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the three-factor registered family
